[SWS_DM_01952] No security level checks if no securityLevel inside the diag- nostic access permission
⌈
If the Diagnostic Server instance is evaluating the security level to execute the
current diagnostic service and no DiagnosticAccessPermission or Diagnosti-
cAccessPermission.securityLevel references are configured, the Diagnostic
Service instance shall directly execute the diagnostic service and skip the security
level checks.
⌋
